therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: amyloid precursor protein processing and beta-amyloid clearance
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults at risk for Alzheimer's disease
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Changes in CSF Beta-amyloid-42 levels compared to baseline at 18 months

results.effect_size: Simvastatin ratio 1.01 (95% CI: 0.96–1.07) vs Placebo ratio 0.98 (95% CI: 0.95–1.02)
biomarker_changes: CSF Beta-amyloid-42 ratio at 18 months: Simvastatin 1.01, Placebo 0.98 — no significant difference
CSF Beta-amyloid-40 ratio at 18 months: Simvastatin 1.03, Placebo 0.98 — no significant difference
CSF sAPP-alpha ratio at 18 months: Simvastatin 0.96, Placebo 1.03
CSF sAPP-beta ratio at 18 months: Simvastatin 0.98, Placebo 1.00
CSF Total tau ratio at 18 months: Simvastatin 1.01, Placebo 1.01 — no difference
CSF Phosphorylated tau ratio at 18 months: Simvastatin 1.16, Placebo 1.15 — no significant difference
subgroup_findings: sAPP-alpha: Simvastatin 0.96 vs Placebo 1.03 — slight decrease in simvastatin arm
sAPP-beta: Simvastatin 0.98 vs Placebo 1.00 — no meaningful difference
Total tau: Simvastatin 1.01 vs Placebo 1.01 — identical
Phosphorylated tau: Simvastatin 1.16 vs Placebo 1.15 — no meaningful difference
